objective: Define the minimal implementation boundary for an observable wrapper-mediated Verilator-facing bridge ordering before launcher start, without adding implementation code or claiming bridge-path launcher execution in this definition gate.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The source review accepted only a blocked-before-runtime-attempt failure record. This definition describes a future callable implementation boundary, but it does not implement that callable path, start the launcher, run sidecar stages, reach compare, or measure timing.
reason: the accepted blocked run evaluation shows reviewed metadata is ready but observable bridge ordering before launcher start is missing before any runtime attempt can begin
the separate process-to-launcher CLI run remains prerequisite evidence, not bridge-path authority
a future implementation must make the ordering observable before launcher start rather than relying on exact argv materialization alone
the first implementation should remain importable helper code, not a broad public CLI or Verilator runtime/ABI change
timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, and production throughput need a proven bridge-path launcher start first

failure_class_boundary.verilator_process_parse_failure: the wrapper-mediated Verilator-facing invocation rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: target/template/shape/source context is absent before bridge or launcher start
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: reviewed source closure or template authority is absent, mismatched, or replaced by an unreviewed sidecar context source ref
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_bridge_failure: reviewed bridge metadata cannot be tied to exact process-to-launcher CLI metadata or observable ordering before launcher start
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the future helper attempts launcher start from structured argv but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_observable_ordering_implementation_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether the implementation boundary is narrow enough for a first callable ordering helper
whether the future helper may live in the existing bridge fixture module without creating another public CLI
whether reviewed bridge metadata, process-to-launcher metadata, explicit sidecar context, ordering trace, launcher start, sidecar stages, compare, and timing evidence stay separate
whether observable ordering before launcher start is required before any bridge-path launcher-start claim
whether generated command text, generated reports, and artifacts remain noncanonical and non-authoritative
whether timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain out of scope
must_not_claim: Verilator-process-to-launcher runtime execution by this definition gate

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
